as_told.title: Hawkeye 360 patent as how aliens could track implant beacons

plain: An engineer named Bob McGwier, who appears on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels in an episode that calls him a CIA contractor (the CIA is the US spy agency), talks about a patent he says he wrote. He says he never believed the stories about aliens putting small implants in people and tracking them, until he wrote a patent that explains how that tracking could work. In another part of the same interview he names it as a patent linked to Hawkeye 360, and says it describes how aliens would find these beacons all over the planet. McGwier is the only teller, and he comes back to it twice, the second time giving the patent a name. If true, it would mean the method behind those abduction stories is set out in an ordinary patent.
